thread:
maria chen: Hey folks, onboarding note. I ran the new quant3 conversion (galactica-xxl-rlhf variant) through our long-prefill harness and see reproducible divergence after ~48k tokens. Short prefill (<=50k) is fine, 65k triggers a logit drift + repetition burst. Dumped kv-cache for inspection.

kai ng: any signs of RoPE misalignment or kv key collisions? quick sanity numbers would help.

maria chen: decode trace + per-token logits attached. Prefill=65000 -> decode diverges at step ~65540. KV dump shows repeated/similar key entries wrapping around to low indexes.

ashley rao: paste the failing run command so we can replicate.

maria chen: run command:
```
./tools/longprefill_eval --model=galactica-xxl-quant3 --prefill=65000 --device=gpu0 --batch=1 --save-kv=/tmp/kvdump_65000 --check-kv
```

dev-bot: CI longprefill job #4321 triggered for galactica-xxl-quant3

jonah p: hypothesis: quant3 pipeline changed phase multiplier or clip behavior for rotary embeddings. Small rounding bias could accumulate across positions and show up after many tokens.

kai ng: also possible: index packing in runtime. If some index field was compacted to 16-bit, >65535 positions would wrap and produce duplicate keys.

maria chen: KV snippet around the anomaly (hex trimmed):
```
pos 65520: key_hash=0x7f12.. norm=12.0
pos 65534: key_hash=0x3b8e.. norm=11.8
pos 65536: key_hash=0x0a1f.. norm=0.97
pos 20: key_hash=0x0a1f.. norm=0.97
```
You can see near-identical keys at 65536 and 20.

ashley rao: that definitely looks like a wrap. Any recent runtime changes that pack kv metadata?

ops-bot: perf-image deployed includes commit 6a7b9c1: "kv-index-packing v3.0 - pack index to uint16 when context <= 65536 to save memory".

jonah p: there it is. That heuristic assumed models won't prefill past 65k. Our long-prefill harness intentionally goes beyond to stress long-context behavior.

kai ng: but why only with quant3 builds? Maybe quant3 memory layout triggered alternate code path that uses the packed layout (e.g., smaller struct) to save RAM for quantized tensors.

maria chen: I instrumented the runtime: for quantized models the runtime enables compact kv layout. So combination (quant3 + packing heuristic) = wrap.

ashley rao: mitigation options:
- revert packing heuristic for quantized models
- when model.metadata.long_context==true, force 32-bit indices
- runtime runtime-check that rejects prefills > pack_limit with clear error

kai ng: prefer forcing uint32 when model flags long_context. Memory cost is small vs correctness.

maria chen: implemented local patch changing pack width to uint32 if model.metadata.max_context > 65536 and re-ran the eval. No wrap, logits stable, perplexity back to baseline.

dev-bot: job #4321 rerun on branch fix/kv-index-width -> SUCCESS

jonah p: can we add an automated onboarding gate: when a model claims long_context, run a smoke prefill test (100k tokens) on submit? That would catch this earlier.

ashley rao: yes: add to model-onboard CI: if meta.long_context true OR manifest.context > 65536, run longprefill-smoke nightly and on-PR.

maria chen: opening PR with fixes: runtime guard + unit tests for kv packing + a quantization-specific test that injects tiny rotary multiplier perturbations to ensure no aliasing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/pull/512

kai ng: also add monitoring: in Console show a warning when a model uses quantized artifacts with compacted metadata and context claim > packing_limit.

ashley rao: and add onboarding checklist line: "run prefill at 2x max_context_claim".

maria chen: follow-up: audit other packing heuristics (shard offsets, prefill stride fields) for similar upper-bound assumptions. I'll create a tech-debt task and schedule a spike.

ops-bot: rolling deploy scheduled: runtime 6a7b9c1 -> 6b8c0f5 to canary at 03:00 UTC.

jonah p: thumbs up. Once PR merges, update galactica-xxl-quant3 metadata to document the quant3 nuance: "quant3 conversion can slightly perturb rotary phase multipliers; ensure kv-index width is set to support claimed context".

maria chen: noted. I'll mark this resolved after the runtime PR merges and we update the model metadata and onboarding checklist.

ashley rao: :thumbsup:
